_note: Reporters Feed. `feed` is an rss.app bridge over Josh's X List (@ApolloJosh1/MLB Reporters), which is what makes this automatic — X itself no longer renders profile or list timelines for logged-out visitors. `reporters` supplies display names and beats, matched on the handle in dc:creator; anyone retweeted into the list who isn't listed here still shows, using their handle. Add a reporter to the X List and they appear here on the next refresh, no code change.
